title: Ingest/learner inject knowledge as orphan nodes — note-linking step is missing
summary: Confirmed via live graph: 51 of 94 note nodes have ZERO edges; 40 of 55 [ingest] notes are orphans. Root cause: both ingest paths (bench/ingest/inject.js:150-161 and scripts/onboard-learn.js:177-181) funnel through POST /overlay/note (daemon.js:1249), which creates the note via addNoteNode but never wires it. inject.js wires ONLY structure.json depends-on edges among struct module nodes; the git/doc knowledge notes get nothing. The daemon's autowireNewTask (daemon.js:510) cannot rescue them — it only writes context edges INTO newlySeen *tasks* (consumers), never into notes, and notes are timestamped at creation (validFrom) so they never appear in newlySeen on a later build. FIX (note-as-provider, in the daemon): in /overlay/note after addNoteNode, build the graph, run scoreMatches(g, newNote) and addEdge(note -> neighbor, kind:context, weight:score) for the top-K matches >= DEFAULT_AUTOWIRE_THRESHOLD (0.25), so the note's summary FLOWS OUT into related open tasks/notes. Cap K (~5) to avoid a clique among the heavily-overlapping ingest notes; skip done-task targets. Plus a one-time backfill to re-wire the existing 40 orphans. One daemon change fixes both ingest and learner because both share the endpoint.
